integrity: All trees through order eight are generated exhaustively from Prüfer sequences and quotiented by a complete tree-isomorphism center code. Centralization values are computed exactly; the displayed spider witness is also reconstructed independently from degree and tree-component betweenness formulas.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns Freeman degree and geodesic-betweenness centralization on finite simple trees compared at fixed order. It establishes the first strict tree-ranking reversal but does not classify all larger-order reversals or alternative betweenness notions.
title: Degree and betweenness centralization first reverse on trees at eight vertices
